status: One hostile deterministic offline comparator, fixed after viewing feasibility and restricted-rank scores and before any all-stream edit-distance or ordinal results.
units: Reuse the exact 212 directed source event, target role records of assembly101_occurrence_screen_20261120.json. Same 34 unordered recording pairs and 12 same-toy groups, different participants. The annotation-only scorer supplies one marked fine occurrence in source and target occurrence for evaluation. Recover corresponding events by (physical sequence,start_frame,end_frame,verb,noun).
predictors: Whole unfiltered fine event streams from validation.csv in each physical recording. Deduplicate exact (start,end,verb,noun) per sequence and discard zero/nonpositive event duration only. Order by (start,end,verb,noun) to form a total order for simultaneous hand actions. Predictors only see the resulting ordered (verb,noun) tokens and source marked position; coarse phase, toy ID, physical timestamps, phase boundaries, target labels and candidate counts from the original filter are unavailable. All target events with the source verb+noun are candidates, including events outside assembly.
alignment: Give each matching candidate the sum of unit-cost Levenshtein distances between source and target prefixes before the marks and suffixes after the marks. Substitution, insertion and deletion cost 1; exact token match costs zero. Choose minimum sum, fractional credit 1/k if correct among k minimizing candidates, zero otherwise.
ordinal: Same all-stream candidates. Absolute ordinal chooses target occurrence of closest ordinal to source (clamp above range to last); also report strict integer ordinal counting overflow as failure. Relative ordinal uses ranks 0..n-1 and minimizes absolute difference of ranks divided by n-1, with fractional ties. Chance is 1/number of target occurrences. Both source and target have at least two matching occurrences by construction.
report: Micro fractional top one, unique-only hits, any-hit ties-inclusive, ambiguous tie count, equal-weight unordered pair mean, mean chance, and toy/pair counts. No fitting, threshold or tuning. An offline alignment of complete annotated streams can use future evidence and ground-truth fine actions. It measures localization and cannot establish online control performance.
